_doc: Timing combo Mavuika. Sua so roi khoi dong lai app la an, khong can build lai.
event = [moc_ms, hanh_dong]. c_down/c_up = giu/nha chuot trai (trong kich),
d_down/d_up = giu/nha Shift (luot), q_down/q_up = phim Q (chieu no), end = het.
'loop'        GIU nut thi lap lai chuoi; nha nut hoac alt-tab = dung ngay.
'once'        GIU nut chay het chuoi 1 lan, KHONG lap; nha nut = ngat giua chung.
Dung cho combo dai: thuc chien co nhieu bien so, phai ngat duoc.
'once_locked' Chay het chuoi bat ke nha nut; chi alt-tab khoi game moi dung.
Chi dung khi chac chan khong can ngat (vd danh dummy).
beat_*: nhip nho dung cho combo tu tao (palette Mavuika), khong hien o danh sach combo.

beat_q._nguon: File 'Mav OL full rotation.amc' - tach tung nhip

beat_c._nguon: File 'Mav OL full rotation.amc' - tach tung nhip
beat_c._ghichu: Nhip C: charge ngan 300ms roi nha, nghi 60ms (tong 360ms).

beat_d._nguon: File 'Mav OL full rotation.amc' - tach tung nhip

beat_cd._nguon: File 'Mav OL full rotation.amc' - tach tung nhip
beat_cd._ghichu: Nhip CD: giu C, dash cat o 200ms, nha C o 442ms, nghi 90ms (tong 532ms).

beat_cdf._nguon: File 'Mav OL full rotation.amc' - tach tung nhip
beat_cdf._ghichu: Nhip CDF: nhu CD nhung giu them 1000ms roi nha ra F, nghi 853ms (tong 2144ms).

beat_click._nguon: Do click N1 64ms trong file 'mavuika CDN1.amc'
beat_click._ghichu: Click 1 cai: nhan chuot trai 64ms roi nha, nghi 60ms (tong 124ms).

beat_click2._nguon: Do click N1 64ms trong file 'mavuika CDN1.amc'
beat_click2._ghichu: Click 2 cai: moi cai 64ms, cach nhau 100ms, nghi 60ms (tong 288ms). Doi nhip thi sua moc 164.
